summary: Sempra (NYSE: SRE) today reported second-quarter 2026 earnings, prepared in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), of $796 million or $1.21 per diluted share, compared to second-quarter 2025 GAAP earnings of $461 million or $0.71 per diluted share.
